title: Binary products of finite simplicial sets are finite
statement: Let $X$ and $Y$ be simplicial sets in one universe, each having finitely many nondegenerate simplices [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. Their degreewise product, with $(X\times Y)_n=X_n\times Y_n$ and coordinatewise simplicial operators, also has finitely many nondegenerate simplices.
